limits: Bounded observation on real native OMP manager and PA in a separate Startup namespace; read failures were injected into the production factory dependencies, not the live human queue.
HTTP 503 during forced read failures is intentional degraded status; the process and PA scheduling remain active and HTTP 200 returns after reads recover.
Existing interrupted claims remain recorded for explicit reconciliation. No technical work was silently replayed.
Only isolated proof processes and tabs were stopped. The live sythelabs Startup remains running.
